title: IoT Lakehouse Data Trust – SLO Tower

list.name: home_id
list.label: Homes
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT home_id FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min WHERE dt >= date_format(current_date - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Freshness – seconds since latest event
panels.description: Wall-clock minus MAX(ts) on bronze (sensor_data_raw). Goes red when older than the SLO target.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT COALESCE(date_diff('second', MAX(ts), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 999999) AS value
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_raw
WHERE dt >= date_format(current_date - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND ts >= CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '15' MINUTE AS TIMESTAMP(3))
  AND plug_id = 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})

panels.title: Completeness % – critical fields (last 5 min)
panels.description: % of raw rows in the last 5 minutes with non-NULL voltage AND current_amp AND power_factor AND ts. Scoped to a short window to keep the SLO read cheap on a 3-worker Trino cluster.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT 100.0 *
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN voltage IS NOT NULL
                     AND current_amp IS NOT NULL
                     AND power_factor IS NOT NULL
                     AND ts IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_raw
WHERE dt >= date_format(current_date - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND ts >= CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '5' MINUTE AS TIMESTAMP(3))
  AND plug_id = 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})

panels.title: Voltage in-range % (10-min windows)
panels.description: % of 10-min general-meter windows whose avg_voltage falls within the [210, 250] V band (typical EU mains tolerance). Computed on the silver layer to keep query cost low.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT 100.0 *
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN avg_voltage BETWEEN 210 AND 250 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
  AND plug_id = 'general'

panels.title: Ingestion velocity (events/s, last 10-min window)
panels.description: Derived from SUM(samples) on the most recent 10-min silver window divided by 600s. Approximates the live event-rate without scanning bronze.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(window_start) AS w
  FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
  WHERE dt >= date_format(current_date - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d')
    AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(samples), 0) / 600.0 AS value
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min, latest
WHERE dt >= date_format(current_date - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND window_start = latest.w
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})

panels.title: Medallion fan-out – rows by layer
panels.description: Bronze (raw, approximated via SUM(samples) on silver to avoid scanning the full bronze table) → Silver 10-min → Silver 30-min. Confirms aggregation pipelines populated the curated layers.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT '0_bronze_raw_approx' AS layer, COALESCE(SUM(samples), 0) AS rows FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
UNION ALL
SELECT '1_silver_10min', COUNT(*) FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
UNION ALL
SELECT '2_silver_30min', COUNT(*) FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_30min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
ORDER BY layer

panels.title: Arrival pulse (events/min, 10-min granularity)
panels.description: Events-per-minute on each 10-min silver window (SUM(samples) / 10). Cheaper than a per-minute scan of bronze and still tracks throughput trends.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  window_start AS time,
  SUM(samples) / 10.0 AS value,
  'events_per_minute' AS metric
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: Out-of-range windows per 10 min – stacked
panels.description: Counts of 10-min silver windows whose avg_voltage or avg_pf fall outside expected bands. Computed on the curated layer to keep the panel light on the Trino cluster.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT window_start AS t, avg_voltage, avg_pf
  FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
  WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                        AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
    AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
    AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
)
SELECT t AS time,
       SUM(CASE WHEN avg_voltage IS NOT NULL AND (avg_voltage < 210 OR avg_voltage > 250) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value,
       'voltage_out_of_range' AS metric
FROM base GROUP BY t
UNION ALL
SELECT t AS time,
       SUM(CASE WHEN avg_pf IS NOT NULL AND (avg_pf < 0 OR avg_pf > 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value,
       'pf_out_of_range' AS metric
FROM base GROUP BY t
UNION ALL
SELECT t AS time,
       SUM(CASE WHEN avg_voltage IS NULL OR avg_pf IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value,
       'null_aggregate' AS metric
FROM base GROUP BY t
ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: End-to-end latency by home – staleness leaderboard (last 15 min)
panels.description: Per home: seconds between newest general-meter raw event and wall clock, scanned over the last 15 minutes only. Sorted laggiest first.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  home_id,
  date_diff('second', MAX(ts), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS lag_seconds,
  MAX(ts)                                          AS latest_event,
  COUNT(*)                                         AS rows_in_window
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_raw
WHERE dt >= date_format(current_date - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND ts >= CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '15' MINUTE AS TIMESTAMP(3))
  AND plug_id = 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY lag_seconds DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Aggregation freshness – minutes since last commit per layer
panels.description: Gap between MAX(window_end) on each curated layer and wall clock. If a layer drifts above its schedule cadence, the corresponding aggregation job is stalled.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT 'sensor_data_10min' AS layer,
       MAX(window_end)                                                AS latest_window,
       date_diff('minute', MAX(window_end), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)        AS lag_minutes
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE dt >= date_format(current_date - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sensor_data_30min' AS layer,
       MAX(window_end),
       date_diff('minute', MAX(window_end), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_30min
WHERE dt >= date_format(current_date - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
ORDER BY layer

panels.title: Schema coverage today – distinct homes & rows by layer
panels.description: Per layer: distinct home_id count, partitions populated and rows in window. Bronze stats are approximated via SUM(samples) on the 10-min silver to avoid scanning the bronze table.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT '0_bronze_raw_approx' AS layer,
       COUNT(DISTINCT home_id)        AS distinct_homes,
       COUNT(DISTINCT dt)             AS partitions_dt,
       COALESCE(SUM(samples), 0)      AS rows_in_window
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
UNION ALL
SELECT '1_silver_10min',
       COUNT(DISTINCT home_id),
       COUNT(DISTINCT dt),
       COUNT(*)
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
UNION ALL
SELECT '2_silver_30min',
       COUNT(DISTINCT home_id),
       COUNT(DISTINCT dt),
       COUNT(*)
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_30min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
ORDER BY layer
